property_summary: After any call to updateRoundImplementation, the function must have either reverted or updated roundImplementation to the given address; the mutant always reverts, but the reference succeeds for a non-zero address, so for any non-zero address the reference will not revert while the mutant always reverts.
change_summary: Replace the require statement that checks newRoundImplementation is not zero address with a statement that always reverts, so updateRoundImplementation can never succeed.
